title: Nonnegative lower bound from a squared estimate
statement:
Let $C,\delta,z\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $C\ge1$, $\delta>0$, $\delta\le1/(10C)$, and $z\ge0$. If
\[
1-\delta-16C^2\delta^2\log_2\!\left(\frac1{C\delta}\right)\le z^2,
\]
then, defining $\eta=16C^2\delta^2\max\!\left\{\log_2\!\left(\frac1{C\delta}\right),1\right\}$, one has
\[
1-\frac{\delta}{2}-2\eta\le z.
\]
